purpose: Single runtime entry point for MathBridge content assembly.
runtime_sequence: If PEP revised series is selected, resolve verified grade/semester/unit placement and apply PEP corrections.
Load PEP subsection/lesson detail only where evidence supports it; resolve artifact identity and rollout separately.
Resolve England or Common Core progression independently; apply selected US state overlay where available.
Load stored comparison copy in selected language.
Load canonical misconception/evidence class and diagnostic route.
Resolve evidence locators and status labels.
hard_rules: Use England for the statutory National Curriculum in England.
Common Core is a US baseline, not one nationwide US curriculum.
Do not infer same-numbered grade equivalence.
Do not use legacy PEP as current.
Exact revised PEP grade/semester/unit placement may be shown from the authoritative series sequence; do not promote unverified subsection/page detail.
Do not treat PEP series design as proof of nationwide or locality-specific classroom use.
Do not infer national classroom practice frequency from curriculum or guidance.
Every misconception must retain its canonical evidence class.
One wrong answer is not a diagnosis.
Teacher-facing copy is direct, educational and non-promotional.
